What is Looka?

AI logo maker and brand identity generator. You answer questions about your industry, name and style preferences, and it generates logo options, then produces a full brand kit of derived assets - business cards, social profiles, letterheads and more.

Best for

Getting a serviceable logo and full brand kit for a small business at low cost.

Main features

  • AI logo generation from industry, name and style preferences
  • logo editor for colours, fonts, layout and symbols
  • Brand Kit generating 300+ branded templates and assets from the chosen logo
  • social media profile and post templates
  • business card and stationery design
  • website builder with brand applied
  • high-resolution and vector file export
  • brand guidelines document
  • unlimited logo changes after purchase.

Practical use cases

  • Creating a logo for a new business in an evening
  • producing a consistent brand kit across social, print and web
  • generating business cards and letterhead that match
  • building a simple branded website
  • refreshing an existing visual identity cheaply.

Who is it for?

  • Small business owners, startups, freelancers and side-project founders who need a logo without hiring a designer.

Pricing, free access & limits

One-time purchase for logo files; subscription for brand kit and website

Plans described in the source

Free to design and preview - payment is required only to download. Basic Logo Package one-time around $20-24 for high-resolution PNG files. Premium Logo Package one-time around $65 for full vector files (SVG, EPS, PDF), transparent backgrounds, colour variations and unlimited changes. Brand Kit subscription around $96/yr (roughly $8/mo) or around $129 one-year for 300+ branded templates. Brand Kit Web around $129-192/yr adding the website builder and hosting. Looka runs frequent discounts.

Free plan

Free to generate and preview logos indefinitely; no free downloads.

Free trial

No trial - the free design-and-preview flow is the evaluation route.

Usage limits to consider

You can design freely but cannot download anything without paying. Vector files require the Premium package. Brand Kit template access ends if the subscription lapses, though purchased logo files remain yours.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Extremely low cost relative to hiring a designer - a usable identity for the price of a meal
  • the brand kit generating 300+ consistent assets from one logo saves real time for a solo founder
  • unlimited post-purchase changes on Premium is genuinely useful
  • no design skill needed at all.

Limitations to consider

  • Logos are algorithmically assembled from icon libraries, so distinctiveness is limited and similar logos are generated for other businesses - trademark risk is real and Looka does not conduct trademark clearance
  • no design strategy or brand thinking, just visual assembly
  • Arabic and non-Latin typography support is poor
  • subscription dependency for the brand kit
  • a professional designer will produce a materially better and defensible identity.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • downloadable file formats (PNG, SVG, EPS, PDF)

Languages

  • English interface; logos can use any script, though Arabic typography options are very limited

API access

No public API

Integrations and exports

  • Direct export
  • website builder with custom domain
  • social platform sizing presets

Evaluation notes

Run a trademark search on any logo before using it commercially - Looka does not do this and algorithmically generated marks can collide with existing registrations. Buy the Premium package if you want vector files; the Basic package's raster-only output will limit you later.
